title: Locality of an integral tensor product with purely inseparable residue extension
statement: Let $R,S,T$ be commutative local rings, each having exactly one maximal ideal, denoted $\mathfrak m_R,\mathfrak m_S,\mathfrak m_T$. Let $R\to S$ and $R\to T$ be local ring homomorphisms, meaning that the inverse images of the target maximal ideals equal $\mathfrak m_R$. Assume $S$ is integral over $R$: every $s\in S$ satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of $R$. Write $\kappa(R)=R/\mathfrak m_R$, $\kappa(S)=S/\mathfrak m_S$, and $\kappa(T)=T/\mathfrak m_T$, with their induced field embeddings. If either $\kappa(S)/\kappa(R)$ or $\kappa(T)/\kappa(R)$ is purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], then $S\otimes_R T$ is a local ring. Here the tensor product is that of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] with multiplication $(s\otimes t)(s'\otimes t')=ss'\otimes tt'$ and identity $1\otimes1$. No Noetherian or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.
